movie.title: Abraham's Boys: A Dracula Story
movie.overview: Max and Rudy Van Helsing have spent their lives under the strict and overprotective rule of their father, Abraham. Unaware of his dark past, they struggle to understand his paranoia and increasingly erratic behavior. But when they begin to uncover the violent truths behind their father’s history with Dracula, their world unravels, forcing them to confront the terrifying legacy they were never meant to inherit.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Raised by an increasingly paranoid and overprotective father, brothers Max and Rudy Van Helsing unravel the terrifying truth of Abraham Van Helsing's violent past with Dracula.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Brothers Max and Rudy Van Helsing have spent their entire lives living under the oppressive, hyper-vigilant rule of their father, Abraham. Long kept in the dark about his history, the boys struggle to comprehend his erratic behavior and relentless paranoia. As they uncover the violent details of their father's past confrontation with Dracula, their world shatters. Ultimately, the brothers are forced to face a horrific legacy that threatens to destroy them.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Max and Rudy Van Helsing grow up in total isolation, enduring the intense, paranoid discipline of their father, Abraham. To the young boys, Abraham is a tyrant whose strict rules and strange behaviors make little sense. As tension builds within the household, Max and Rudy begin investigating their father's hidden past to make sense of their lives. Their search leads them to horrific revelations about Abraham's brutal victory over Count Dracula. They learn that the trauma of that dark encounter never truly left their father, turning his protection into a dangerous obsession. As Abraham's mental state rapidly deteriorates, the line between protective father and monster blurs. The brothers must navigate their father's delusion while coming to terms with the dark inheritance hanging over their family line. In a dramatic escalation, Max and Rudy are forced to decide whether to succumb to the legacy of fear or forge their own path forward.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in the aftermath of Abraham Van Helsing's legendary encounter with Count Dracula, this atmospheric horror-drama shifts focus to Van Helsing's young sons, Max and Rudy. Raised under a shadow of unexplained paranoia, strict discipline, and constant isolation, the boys struggle to understand why their father views the world as a threat. As they dig deeper into Abraham's past, they uncover hidden truths about vampire hunting and the deep-seated psychological trauma left in the monster's wake. The story offers a grounded, character-driven exploration of generational trauma, paranoia, and the terrifying shadow cast by a heroic legacy.

story_structure.climax: Tensions reach a breaking point when the boys directly confront the violent realities of Abraham's past, forcing a terrifying, high-stakes clash between father and sons.
story_structure.conflict: The boys struggle against their father's unyielding demands and terrifying rules, desperate to understand the hidden motivation driving his deep-seated fear and obsession.
story_structure.resolution: The shattering truth reshapes the brothers' understanding of their family, leaving them to grapple with the disturbing inheritance of their father's crusade.
story_structure.introduction: Brothers Max and Rudy live isolated under the strict, paranoid control of their aging father, Abraham Van Helsing, whose erratic behavior and intense discipline stem from secret past trauma.
story_structure.risingAction: Curiosity leads the brothers to investigate their father's locked belongings and mysterious past, gradually uncovering frightening clues about a dark legacy involving legendary horrors.
